shortDescription: Configures Service Profile Templates on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: bios_policy
options.description: The name of the BIOS policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: boot_policy
options.description: The name of the boot order policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the service profile template. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: graphics_card_policy
options.description: The name of the graphics card policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: host_firmware_package
options.description: The name of the host firmware package you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: ipmi_access_profile
options.description: The name of the IPMI access profile you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: iqn_pool
options.description: The name of the IQN pool (initiator) you want to apply to all iSCSI vNICs for service profiles created from this template.

options.name: kvm_mgmt_policy
options.description: The name of the KVM management policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: lan_connectivity_policy
options.description: The name of the LAN connectivity policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: local_disk_policy
options.description: The name of the local disk policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: The name of the maintenance policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: mgmt_inband_pool_name
options.description: How the inband management IPv4 address is derived for the server associated with this service profile.

options.name: mgmt_interface_mode
options.description: The Management Interface you want to assign to service profiles created from this template.

options.name: mgmt_ip_pool
options.description: The name of the Outband Management IP pool you want to use with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: mgmt_ip_state
options.description: The state for the Outband Management IP pool you want to use with service profiles created from this template. Choices are none or pooled.

options.name: mgmt_vnet_name
options.description: A VLAN selected from the associated VLAN group.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the service profile template. This name can be between 2 and 32 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). This name must be unique across all service profiles and service profile templates within the same organization.

options.name: org_dn
options.description: Org dn (distinguished name)

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: power_control_policy
options.description: The name of the power control policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: power_state
options.description: The power state to be applied when a service profile created from this template is associated with a server.

options.name: power_sync_policy
options.description: The name of the power sync policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: san_connectivity_policy
options.description: The name of the SAN connectivity policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: scrub_policy
options.description: The name of the scrub policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: server_pool
options.description: The name of the server pool you want to associate with this service profile template.

options.name: server_pool_qualification
options.description: The name of the server pool policy qualificaiton you want to use for this service profile template.

options.name: sol_policy
options.description: The name of the Serial over LAN (SoL) policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify Service Profile Templates are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify Service Profile Templates are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: storage_profile
options.description: The name of the storage profile you want to associate with service profiles created from this template

options.name: template_type
options.description: The template type field which can be one of the following: initial-template — Any service profiles created from this template are not updated if the template changes. updating-template — Any service profiles created from this template are updated if the template changes.

options.name: threshold_policy
options.description: The name of the threshold policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: user_label
options.description: The User Label you want to assign to service profiles created from this template.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: uuid_pool
options.description: Specifies how the UUID will be set on a server associated with a service profile created from this template. The uuid_pool option can be the name of the UUID pool to use or '' (the empty string). An empty string will use the UUID assigned to the server by the manufacturer, and the UUID remains unassigned until a service profile created from this template is associated with a server. options.name: vmedia_policy
options.description: The name of the vMedia policy you want to associate with service profiles created from this template.
